kind: nowcast (model estimate of observed data not yet published)
scope: EU only: the EU's imports from outside the EU, and six member states (DE, FR, IT, NL, ES, PL)

methods.last_ratio: Comext x the pair's last known BACI/Comext ratio
methods.learned: gradient boosting on last known ratios, size, lag, reporter and basket

settings.full_lag1: complete Comext year, BACI one year behind (like the first nowcast year)
settings.partial_lag2: Comext January-month 7 scaled up, BACI two years behind (like the current year)

sources: Eurostat ert_bil_eur_m, based on ECB euro reference rates (USD per EUR)
caveats: A nowcast estimates what BACI will report; it is not observed data and will be revised when BACI publishes.
BACI's latest year is itself provisional.
Pairs that BACI records but Comext lacks are missing from the nowcast; the backtest error includes this.
The current year is scaled up from its first months using each basket's usual seasonal pattern; a change in pattern (e.g. stockpiling) is not captured.
Bands are the 10th-90th percentile of past nowcast errors, not a guarantee.
